**Variation Grouping Instruction**

*Amazon → Wayfair Variant Mapping Guide*

# **1\. Purpose**

Amazon listings sometimes combine multiple variation attributes (e.g., Colour, Size, and Bulb Option) into a single variation group. Wayfair requires these to be separated into individual Variant Grouping fields. This document explains how to correctly map Amazon's combined variation structure to Wayfair's separate Variant Grouping structure.

# **2\. Field Assignment**

Assign each Amazon variation attribute to its own Wayfair field, in this order:

* Variant Grouping 1 → Colour

* Variant Grouping 2 → Size

* Variant Grouping 3 → Bulb Included

# **3\. Step-by-Step Instructions**

1. Identify how many variation dimensions exist on the Amazon listing (e.g., Colour, Size, Bulb Option).

2. Assign each dimension to its own Variant Grouping field — never combine multiple dimensions into one field, even if Amazon shows them combined.

3. For each Variant Grouping field, fill in two values:

   * Variant Grouping — select the closest standard dropdown option (Color, Size, Style, Pattern, Configuration, etc.). If there is no exact match, type a custom value.

   * Variant Attribute Name On Site — the display name shown to the customer on the front end. This can differ from the Grouping value (e.g., Grouping \= "Size", Display Name \= "Ceiling Rose Diameter").

4. Select the matching Wayfair variation value from the dropdown whenever available. If the required value is not available, manually enter the most appropriate value.

5. If the listing has fewer than 3 variation dimensions, leave the unused Variant Grouping column(s) completely blank.

# **4\. Important Rules**

* Even if Amazon combines all variation attributes into one variation group, do NOT combine them in Wayfair — always split them into separate fields.

* Only fill a Variant Grouping column if that variation dimension genuinely exists for the product.

* Never write "N/A" or any filler text in an unused Variant Grouping column — leave it blank.

* A single combined Amazon attribute (e.g., "Black (120 Ceiling Rose) \+ Bulb") must be split into separate columns (e.g., Colour / Ceiling Rose Size / Bulb Option), with each variant SKU's row carrying the correct value in each column.

# **5\. Available “Variant Grouping” Dropdown Options**

Match your attribute to the closest option below whenever possible:

* Finish

* Shade Color

* Size

* Bulb Type

* Crystal

* Number of Lights

* Bulb Included

* Color Temperature

* Maximum Wattage (per Bulb)

* Voltage

* Pack Size

* Fixture Material

* Adjustable Length

* Shade Material

* Brightness (Lumens)

* Shade Included

* Canopy Included

* Bulb Base

* Bulb Shape

* Glass Type

# **6\. Worked Examples**

## **Example 1 — Colour \+ Ceiling Rose Size \+ Bulb Option (3 dimensions)**

The Amazon listing merges Colour, Ceiling Rose size, and Bulb included/not into one “Colour Name” attribute (see the listing screenshots below — note how “Colour Name” changes between “Black (120 Ceiling Rose)” and “Black (200 Ceiling Rose)”). Split into three separate Variant Groupings:

![][image1]

![][image2]

![][image3]

| Field | Variant Grouping | Variant Attribute Name On Site | Values |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Variant Grouping 1 | Shade Color | Colour | Black, Gold, White, etc. |
| Variant Grouping 2 | Size | Ceiling Rose Size | 120mm, 150mm, etc. (confirm exact sizes from the listing) |
| Variant Grouping 3 | Bulb Included | Bulb Included | With Bulb, Without Bulb |

*Note: “Canopy Included” is also in the dropdown list. Use it only if the variation is a plain yes/no (with canopy vs without canopy), not size-based. If the data shows actual sizes (e.g., “120 Ceiling Rose”), use “Size” instead.*

## **Example 2 — Colour \+ Bulb Option (2 dimensions)**

Only two variation dimensions exist on this listing. Leave Variant Grouping 3 blank.

![][image4]

| Field | Variant Grouping | Variant Attribute Name On Site | Values |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Variant Grouping 1 | Shade Color | Colour | Copper, Silver, Gold, Black, White |
| Variant Grouping 2 | Bulb Included | Set name (or “Bulb Option”) | With bulb, Without bulb |
| Variant Grouping 3 | — leave blank — | — leave blank — | — leave blank — |

## **Example 3 — Colour \+ Pack Size (2 dimensions)**

![][image5]

| Field | Variant Grouping | Variant Attribute Name On Site | Values |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Variant Grouping 1 | Shade Color | Colour | Chrome, Black, Bronze, etc. |
| Variant Grouping 2 | Pack Size | Pack Size | 1 Pack, 2 Pack, 3 Pack, etc. |

# **7\. Quick Reference Mapping**

| Field | Variant Grouping | Variant Attribute Name On Site | Values |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Variant Grouping 1 | — | — | Colour: Black → Colour \= Black |
| Variant Grouping 2 | — | — | Size: 3 Light → Size \= 3 Light |
| Variant Grouping 3 | — | — | Bulb Option: With Bulb → Bulb Option \= With Bulb |

*This ensures Amazon's combined variation structure is correctly mapped to Wayfair's separate variation grouping structure.*
